card: किसी की कही बात अपने शब्दों में बताना = indirect speech। Seema asked Geeta, "What are you doing today?" → Seema asked Geeta what she was doing that day। बदलाव: am → was, I → she, today → that day, will → would।

Kisi ki kahi baat apne shabdon mein bataana = indirect speech. Seema asked Geeta, "What are you doing today?" → Seema asked Geeta what she was doing that day. Badlaav: am → was, I → she, today → that day, will → would.

Telling what someone said in your own words is indirect speech. Seema asked Geeta, "What are you doing today?" → Seema asked Geeta what she was doing that day. Changes: am → was, I → she, today → that day, will → would.

Aadmi ya ladka = he, aurat ya ladki = she, jo dono ho sakte hain (baby, teacher) = he/she, cheezein = it.
A man or boy = he, a woman or girl = she, words that can be either (baby, teacher) = he/she, things = it.
